description: The prime minister requested discharge; discharged ministers continued until a successor government took office.
Speaker assigned exploration of a government tolerated by the Riksdag.
Speaker announced resumption from 5 October with a report deadline of 12 October.
Effective resumption date stated in the 2 October announcement; the later 13 October report confirms continuation of the same exploratory episode.
Speaker received the report; Andersson did not consider further exploration meaningful at that point.
Speaker formally proposed Andersson for an S single-party government; this is separate from the subsequent vote.
Speaker assigned C exploration after conversations following the rejected S proposal.
Speaker received the exploratory report and announced further telephone consultations.
Speaker announced a formal proposal for 30 October and a vote on 3 November.
The parliamentary record confirms the formal proposal and its first tabling.
Speaker assigned M exploration after the C proposal was rejected.
Speaker extended the exploratory task by additional days; other parties remained free to negotiate.
Speaker specified 17 November as the reporting date.
Kristersson reported but could not submit a final report; this was not a formal PM vote.
Speaker gave Kristersson and all other party leaders a one-week adjournment for continuing negotiations.
Speaker announced party consultations and M final reporting for 24 November.
Scheduled consultations with all eight parties and M final reporting; no formal PM ballot date in this notice.
